preconditions.description: The number of points (n) and segments (m) are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 100 for x in points) and len(points) == n
preconditions.description: All point coordinates are integers between 0 and 100, and there are exactly n points.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= l <= r <= 100 for l, r in segments) and len(segments) == m
preconditions.description: All segment bounds are integers with l ≤ r, and there are exactly m segments.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(output) == n and all(c in {0, 1} for c in output))
postconditions.description: If no good drawing exists, output is '-1'; otherwise, output is a list of n integers (0 or 1) representing the color of each point.

postconditions.expression: stdout != '-1' implies all(abs(red_in_segment - blue_in_segment) <= 1 for segment in segments for red_in_segment, blue_in_segment in [(sum(1 for i, x in enumerate(points) if segment[0] <= x <= segment[1] and output[i] == 0), sum(1 for i, x in enumerate(points) if segment[0] <= x <= segment[1] and output[i] == 1))])
postconditions.description: For every segment, the absolute difference between the number of red points and blue points within it is at most 1.
